newsitem.title: USA: Motown Records CEO resigns - Polygram.
newsitem.headline: Motown Records CEO resigns - Polygram.

text.p: Polygram Holding Inc said Monday Andre Harrell has resigned from his post as president and chief executive officer of Motown Records, effective immediately.

While the recruitment for a new Motown President is conducted, Motown's day to day operations will be overseen by its chairman, Clarence Avant, and Motown's senior staff, Polygram said. It attributed the announcement to Roger Ames, president, PolyGram Music Group and the Motown board members.

PolyGram acquired Motown in July 1993. Today, Motown's roster bears over 25 artists, including Boyz II Men, who will release a new album this fall, Diana Ross, Stevie Wonder, Latifah, Zhane, and the hot new group 98 Degrees.
Motown, one of the legendary labels in the music business, was founded in Detroit in 1959 by Berry Gordy Jr.

Motown helped launch the careers of recording stars including; Stevie Wonder, Jackson Five, Diana Ross and The Supremes, the Temptations, Lionel Richie and the Commodores, Smokey Robinson & The Miracles, and The Four Tops.
